a: The periodic table organizes elements by atomic number and recurring chemical properties.
Atomic number Z is the number of protons in an atom's nucleus.
Atomic mass is roughly protons + neutrons (isotopes average for the element).
pH < 7 acidic, pH = 7 neutral, pH > 7 basic. pH = -log10[H+].
Oxidation is loss of electrons; reduction is gain of electrons (OIL RIG).
A covalent bond shares electron pairs between atoms.
An ionic bond forms by transfer of electrons creating attraction between ions.
Exothermic reactions release heat to the surroundings.
Endothermic reactions absorb heat from the surroundings.
A catalyst speeds up a reaction without being consumed.
Stoichiometry uses balanced equations to relate amounts of reactants and products.
Valence electrons are the outermost electrons that determine bonding.
Isotopes are atoms of the same element with different numbers of neutrons.
Molarity M = moles of solute / liters of solution.
A balanced chemical equation has the same number of each atom on both sides.
